::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--gex_reference`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Path of folder containing 10x-compatible reference
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`file` [required]{.arg-required}

[Example]{.arg-key} `"/path/to/refdata-gex-GRCh38-2020-A"`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--input`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
The fastq.gz files to align. Can also be a single directory containing fastq.gz files.

Individual FASTQ files should follow the naming convention of 10x Genomics:
[Sample Name]_S[Sample Number]_L[Lane Number]_[Read Type]_001.fastq.gz

Where:
[Sample Name] is the name assigned during sample preparation/sequencing
S[Sample Number] is the sample index (usually S1, S2, etc.)
L[Lane Number] identifies the sequencing lane (L001, L002, etc.)

[Read Type] will be one of:
R1 - Read 1 (contains the spatial barcode and UMI)
R2 - Read 2 (contains the actual cDNA sequence)
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
List of `file` [required]{.arg-required}

[Example]{.arg-key} `"sample_S1_L001_R1_001.fastq.gz"`, `"sample_S1_L001_R2_001.fastq.gz"`

[Separator]{.arg-key} `";"`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--probe_set`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
CSV file specifying the probe set used. Required for probe-based assays
(FFPE / standard Visium and Visium HD). Omit for Visium HD 3' data.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`file`

[Example]{.arg-key} `"Visium_Human_Transcriptome_Probe_Set_v2.0_GRCh38-2020-A.csv"`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--cytaimage`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Brightfield image generated by the CytAssist instrument.
When using CytAssist workflow, either this or --image must be provided.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`file`

[Example]{.arg-key} `"cyta_image.tif"`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--image`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
H&E or fluorescence microscope image in TIFF or JPG format.
Required for standard Visium workflow, optional when using --cytaimage for CytAssist workflow.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`file`

[Example]{.arg-key} `"brightfield.tif"`
:::
::::
:::::

### Segmentation Options

::::: {.arg-table role="table"}
:::: {.arg-row .arg-head role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="columnheader"}
Name

Description

Attributes
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--nucleus_segmentation`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Enable or disable nucleus and cell segmentation for Visium HD / HD 3' H&E samples.
When unset, Space Ranger runs segmentation by default if an H&E image is provided.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`boolean`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--custom_segmentation_file`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Custom nucleus segmentation mask to use instead of the built-in algorithm.
Requires --nucleus_expansion_distance_micron.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`file`

[Example]{.arg-key} `"nucleus_segmentation.geojson"`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--nucleus_expansion_distance_micron`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Distance in microns to expand each nucleus to approximate the cell boundary.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`double`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--max_nucleus_diameter_px`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Maximum nucleus diameter in pixels, for samples with exceptionally large cells.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`integer`

[Min]{.arg-key} `1`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--umi_registration`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Enable or disable UMI-based registration that aligns the microscope image to the UMI
count data for Visium HD. When unset, Space Ranger applies its default.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`boolean`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--umi_to_image_offset`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Supply a custom offset (as accepted by Space Ranger) to override UMI-to-image
registration when automatic convergence is incorrect.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`string`
:::
::::
:::::

::::: {.arg-table role="table"}

::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--cell_annotation_model`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Cloud-based cell type annotation model to use (Visium HD / HD 3' only, requires
segmentation), which requires --tenx_cloud_token_path. When left out, Space Ranger
still annotates human samples with the bundled Pan-Human Azimuth model, which runs
locally and needs no token.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`string`

[Choices]{.arg-key} `"auto"`, `"human_pca_v1_beta"`, `"mouse_pca_v1_beta"`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--tenx_cloud_token_path`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Path to a 10x Cloud token JSON, required for cloud-based annotation models.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`file`

[Example]{.arg-key} `"tenx_cloud_token.json"`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--disable_cell_annotation`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Disable cell type annotation.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`boolean_true`
:::

## Example commands

You can run the pipeline using `nextflow run`.

### View help

You can use `--help` as a parameter to get an overview of the possible parameters.

```bash
nextflow run openpipelines-bio/openpipeline_spatial \
  -r v0.7.0 -latest \
  -main-script target/nextflow/mapping/spaceranger_count/main.nf \
  --help
```

### Run command

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="Create a params.yaml"}
The command below reads this component's arguments from a `params.yaml` file. To create one:

- generate it with the form on [Viash Hub](https://www.viash-hub.com/packages/openpipeline_spatial/v0.7.0/components/mapping/spaceranger_count);
- see examples of using params files in the [guides](/guides/index.qmd);
- run several samples in one go with a [`param_list`](/guides/process-many-samples.qmd).
:::

Run locally with:

```bash
nextflow run openpipelines-bio/openpipeline_spatial \
  -r v0.7.0 -latest \
  -profile docker \
  -main-script target/nextflow/mapping/spaceranger_count/main.nf \
  -params-file params.yaml
```

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="Other backends and platforms"}
Replace `-profile docker` with `-profile podman` or `-profile singularity` depending on the desired backend. To run on Seqera Platform or through Viash Hub, see the [guides](/guides/index.qmd).
:::
